sentences.en: I can't swallow these tablets without a drink of water.
sentences.zh: 我不能空着肚子吃这些药片。

sentences.en: He swallowed a piece of toast because he was starving.
sentences.zh: 他饿得厉害，吞下了一块烤面包。

sentences.en: It takes more than one swallow to make a summer.
sentences.zh: 单凭一次燕子归来并不能说明夏天就要来了。

senses.zh: 燕子，吞咽，一次吞咽的量
吞下，咽下，忍受，不流露感情收回
咽口水，忍气吞声，吞下，咽下
